page_title: Spotify & Apple Music Player for Mac | Tuneful

sources.entry: Tuneful - Controller for Spotify and Apple Music from the menu bar or mini player. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/tuneful/id6739804295?platform=mac)

summary.name: Tuneful
summary.one_liner: Tuneful is a Mac app that controls Spotify and Apple Music from the MacBook notch, the menu bar, or a floating mini player.
use_cases: Control Spotify or Apple Music without opening the full app
Skip, pause, shuffle or repeat from the menu bar
Show music controls in the MacBook notch
Save currently playing songs to Spotify Liked Songs
summary.what_it_does: Tuneful lets you play, pause, skip, shuffle, repeat and set volume for Spotify and Apple Music from a menu bar player, a floating mini player, or an auto-hiding notch player that appears when you hover over the MacBook notch. It supports swipe gestures on the trackpad with haptic feedback. Buttons and shortcuts can be customized, and settings sync across multiple Macs. Optional integrations let you save tracks to Spotify Liked Songs (requires a Spotify Developer account) and scrobble to Last.fm (requires a Last.fm account).
notable: Notch player that works on any display, not just notched MacBooks
Built in Swift; claims about 0.1% CPU at idle and about 60 MB RAM
Sync of settings across all Macs
Redesigned look for macOS Tahoe with glass mini players
caveats: Spotify Liked Songs integration requires a Spotify Developer account
Last.fm scrobbling requires a Last.fm account
Pricing is not stated on the page; the App Store listing is linked but its price is not shown
